agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on 10 December 2025 in Emergency Preparedness and Protective Services Committee Report 20.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on Wednesday, 19 November 2025, and the deadline to register to speak by email is 8:30 am on Thursday, 20 November 2025.

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
At the outset, the following Motion was introduced by Vice-Chair Hill to add the necessary Budget documents to the current meeting agenda, as the agenda had been published two days in advance of the tabling of the Draft 2026 City of Ottawa Budget on Wednesday, 12 November 2025.
Motion No. EPPSC 2025-20-01
Moved by Vice-Chair D. Hill:
WHEREAS the 2026 Draft Operating and Capital Budget documents for the Emergency Preparedness and Protective Services Committee were circulated and published after being tabled at Council on November 12, 2025, which was after the Emergency Preparedness and Protective Services Committee agenda publication date; 
THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED that, pursuant to Subsection 89(3) of the Procedure By-law, the Emergency Preparedness and Protective Services Committee approve that the budget documents be added to the Agenda of Thursday, 20 November 2025.
Carried
Chair Brockington then introduced Messrs. Ryan Perrault, General Manager, Emergency and Protective Services Department (EPSD), and Cyril Rogers, Chief Finance Officer and City Treasurer.
Mr. Perrault then introduced the following:
Mr. Rogers and departmental staff then spoke to two detailed slide presentations which served as overviews of the Committee’s portion of the 2026 City of Ottawa Budget.  Copies of these presentations are held on file with the Office of the City Clerk.
Prior to the receipt of public delegations, Vice-Chair Hill read out the following ‘Roadmap’ Motion:
Motion No. EPPSC 2025-20-02
Moved by Vice-Chair D. Hill:
That the Emergency Preparedness and Protective Services Committee recommend Council, sitting as Committee of the Whole, approve the Emergency Preparedness and Protective Services Committee 2026 Draft Operating and Capital Budgets as follows:
The Committee then heard from the following delegations:
[ + Slide presentations are held on file with the Office of the City Clerk. ]
Following questions to the presenters and to staff, and at the conclusion of Committee discussions, the recommendations presented in Motion No. EPPSC 2025-20-02 were put before Committee and were ‘CARRIED’, as presented.
Carried
